g.text: ECO assembly: DACs -> configuration links -> drivers TURBO assembly: DACs -> 4 buffers -> links -> drivers

g.desc: ECO assembly: DACs -> configuration links -> drivers TURBO assembly: DACs -> 4 buffers -> links -> drivers

g.text: Functional draft: six connected circuit sheets, custom symbols, netlist validation and review notes.

g.desc: Functional draft: six connected circuit sheets, custom symbols, netlist validation and review notes.

g.text: No headphone jack or BGA audio muxes: four solder pads wire directly to the installed drivers.

g.desc: No headphone jack or BGA audio muxes: four solder pads wire directly to the installed drivers.

g.text: RF matching, battery thermal/current limits, USB-C charge policy and amplifier load stability need validation.

g.text: 250mW output, 130dBA system performance, <10ms latency and 33/47h runtime are targets, not measurements.
